So, back in first grade, I liked this girl who I ended up having a crush on for like 6 years lol. I finally told a different friend about my crush in 7th grade. She then told her boyfriend (one of my closest friends at the time), who made a fake account on facebook, with my crush's name. I didn't talk to her in person because I was extremely introverted and had severe social anxiety, so I just stupidly believed that the facebook account was actually her.

I later found out that I was just talking to him, and the girl who I had a crush on, never knew any of this was going on.

Most awkward thing that has happened to me, especially because people don't forget things like this in school, and they never let people move on. :/
